title: What's New: Understanding Copilot Credit Consumptions for Your Business Central Agent

chapters.title: Accessing Consumption Data - Agent List View

features.name: Copilot credit consumption overview
features.description: A feature that allows users to view and assess how much Copilot credits are consumed by agents on a monthly or per-task basis within Business Central.
caveats: Consumption data visibility is restricted to users with agent diagnostics or super user permission sets
Different features consume different amounts of credits

features.name: Agent consumption data in agents list
features.description: Users can access the agents list, select an agent, and view detailed consumption data showing credits charged per action, capability, and specific task.
caveats: Works with both custom-built agents and Microsoft-built agents
Charging model differs per agent type

features.name: Task-level consumption filtering
features.description: Users can filter consumption data by specific task number to see all entries related to a particular multi-turn task and its associated costs.
caveats: Requires clicking on task number in the list

features.name: Agent tasks consumption view
features.description: The agent tasks list displays total Copilot credits consumed per task in a column on the right side, with ability to drill into specific entries.

features.name: Agent diagnostics permission set
features.description: A permission set that controls access to sensitive consumption data, requiring assignment to view Copilot credit consumption details.
caveats: Agent admin permission set alone is insufficient
Only agent diagnostics and super user roles can see consumption data

features.name: Copilot credits bundled with licenses
features.description: Microsoft Business Central licenses include bundled free Copilot credits each month that users receive automatically.

features.name: Copilot credits pay-as-you-go and pre-purchase
features.description: Users can acquire additional Copilot credits beyond their bundled allotment either through pay-as-you-go billing or pre-purchasing credits in advance.
